Crate pads/beds: sized for wire crates.


Round/rectangle pillows: cushioned lounge-style beds for gentler dogs.



If you want, I can help narrow it down by your dog’s chew level and sleep style.

turns.q: Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
turns.replyTail:
beginner needs to get started?
K9 Ballistics • AI Assistant
Yes — a few basics can make your first pick easier:



Measure your dog from nose to base of tail, then compare to the bed’s sleeping area


If your dog likes to sprawl, add about 10 inches


Think about sleep style and whether they need orthopedic support


For crate beds, use the included tie-downs


Some beds need a cover put on after unpacking; elevated armored beds just need the legs screwed in by hand
